Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 3279. 1966 

Indian Standard 

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS FOR 

MUSHROOM VENTILATORS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 1 January 1966, after the draft finalized by the Marine Engineering 
and Shipbuilding Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mecha- 
nical Engineering Division Council. 

0.2 This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on mushroom 
ventilators. Other standards in the series are: 

♦IS : 3280-1966 Dimensions for mushroom ventilators with adjustable 
head-welded type. 

♦IS : 3281-1966 Dimensions for mushroom ventilators with fixed head- 
welded type. 

♦IS: 3282-1966 Dimensions for mushroom ventilators with adjustable 
head-cast iron type. 

♦IS: 3283-1966 Dimensions for mushroom ventilators with adjustable 
head-cast iron type with provision for passage of light. 

0«3 In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from 
NF J 45-100: 1955 *Aerateur specification generale (mushroom ventilator- 
general requirements)' issued by the Association Francaise de Normalisa- 
tion. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960f. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off 
value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard deals with the general requirements of mushroom 
ventilators. 



♦Under print. 

fRulcs for rounding off numerical values ( rwiud ). 



IS: 3279 -1966 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard, the following definitions shall 
apply. 

2.1 Nominal Size — Nominal size of mushroom ventilator is the internal 
diameter of the ventilator body. 

2.2 As the shape of the head resembles that of a mushroom, the ventilator 
as a whole is normally called by this name. 

3. DESCRIPTION 

3.1 The different types of mushroom ventilators used on board merchant 
ships are as follows: 

a) Mushroom ventilator with fixed head: 
1) Welded type 

b) Mushroom ventilator with adjustable head: 

1) Welded type 

2) Cast iron type 

3) Cast iron type with provision for passage of light. 

3.2 With the fixed type, a fabricated head is bolted on to the body 
or post. 

3.3 The adjustable type ventilator consists of a head or hood, body and a 
spindle with or without handle. The body may be welded or bolted to 
the deck. 

4. MATERIAL 

4.1 The material for various parts of mushroom ventilators shall be as 
given in Table 1. 

5. MAINTENANCE 

5.1 With the fixed type of ventilators, the hood shall be removed and 
repainted periodically. 

5.2 Provision shall be made for lubrication of locking handles and turning 
arrangements. 

5.3 Ventilators with adjustable heads shall be removed and the screwed 
portion of the spindle cleaned thoroughly and greased. 

6. DESIGNATION 

6.1 The mushroom ventilators shall be designated by the name, type, the 
nominal size and number of the standard. For designations and examples 
see relevant standards. 



IS, 3279-1966
